author: reek
body: The positive control for the ordering refusal. A `.failing` test cannot see a refusal that reaches too far: if equality on Text had been caught by the same change, every error test would still pass and nothing would say so.

author: reek
body: First, equality on Text is CONTENT equality and always was -- `emit-eq-op` has its own arm calling `__str_eq`. The two texts below are built separately at runtime, so they sit at different addresses; that is the exact pair that made ordering wrong, and equality must be unmoved by it.
